verdict.rationale: Mintlify has a dedicated first-party self-host deployment page saying the product can run inside your own cloud or on-premises, on AWS or any Kubernetes platform including Azure, Google Cloud, Oracle Cloud and OpenShift. An older community comment calling it 'pure SaaS' predates this and does not concretely contradict the documented capability. missing for 10: details on which tier or license grants self-hosting, setup and operational requirements, whether AI features work when self-hosted, independent hands-on corroboration of a self-hosted deployment.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product

citations.quote: Run Mintlify inside your own cloud or on-premises environment, on AWS or any Kubernetes platform including Azure, Google Cloud, Oracle Cloud, and OpenShift.
